{{Quote|I completed a special assignment in the Reega system, and was given permission to come ahead on `unofficial' business.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Brandei]]|<ref name="TP">{{JournalCite|5|Turning Point (Charlene Newcomb)}}</ref>}}
The '''Reega system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Demetras sector/Legends|Demetras sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Brandei]] was in mission in the Reega system before he delivered the young girl [[Alexandra Winger|Alex]] to [[Garos IV]], for adoption by [[Tork Winger|Tork]] and [[Sali Winger]].<ref name="TP" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Non-canon content===
The system was organized around a dying red star and contained twenty-five planets, all uninhabited. On the seventh was hidden a secret, military laboratory from the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] era.<ref name="CAS">"{{CasusBelliCite|94|Grand Moff, droïd assassin & vieux cristaux}}"</ref>
